items.title: ISO 27001 certificate
items.text: Kestrel Freight OS is certified to ISO 27001:2022 for the platform and customer support.

items.title: TISAX label
items.text: Kestrel holds a TISAX assessment level 2 label for information with high protection needs.

items.title: Hosting
items.text: Production and backups run in Microsoft Azure Germany West Central and Germany North.

items.title: DPA
items.text: A data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR is signed with every customer.

items.title: SSO
items.text: Single sign-on supports SAML 2.0 and Microsoft Entra ID.
